title: structured output: constrained decoding backends - CFG/regex/tokenizer fallbacks and edgecase tests
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: users rely on constrained decoding (CFG/grammar + regex constraints) for structured output (JSON, CSV, tool-call payloads). We have observed tokenizer-driven failures where regex-backed constraints and CFG expansion choose tokenization boundaries that produce invalid/partial matches leading to rejected outputs or infinite search. This PR harmonizes constrained decoding logic across the three backends (CFG, regex, token-aware constraints) and introduces a tokenizer-aware fallback path to avoid pathological token-boundary mismatches.

Summary of changes: - CFG engine: tighten expansion ordering and add deterministic token-boundary anchoring to reduce nondeterminism when multiple expansions produce identical surface forms. - Regex backend: add tokenizer-aware prefilter and unicode-aware fallback that attempts a UTF-8 codepoint regex when tokenization prevents a strict byte-level match. - Tokenizer constraints: improved edge-case handling for multi-codepoint grapheme clusters and added a heuristic to prefer whole-token matches for structural symbols (quotes, braces, commas). - Backend shim: unify constraint scoring so CFG/regex/tokenizer backends emit the same failure modes and error messages, making the console/debug traces consistent. - Tests: + comprehensive unit tests for tokenizer edgecases (emoji, combining marks, CJK punctuation) + integration tests exercising mixed-constraint scenarios (CFG + regex + token prefix) + added deterministic seeds for sampling tests to reduce CI flakiness. - Docs: update structured-output.md with guidance on using token-aware regexes and recommended fallback behavior.

This is intended to be a non-breaking behavioral improvement for existing customers but reduces rare failure cases that previously caused retry loops or malformed tool-call payloads.

release_notes:
- Structured output: improved constrained decoding across backends (CFG/regex/tokenizer).
- Added tokenizer-aware regex fallback to avoid tokenization-induced mismatches (reduces malformed structured outputs).
- Addressed tokenizer edge cases (emoji, combining marks, CJK punctuation).
- Added tests and docs; no breaking changes expected.
notes: Observed a small perf regression (~3% median for pathological inputs) when regex fallback triggers; added guidance to docs recommending pre-compiled token-aware regexes for high-throughput workloads. Monitoring: added a telemetry metric structured.constrained_decoding.fallbacks to track how often fallbacks occur in production.
